description: Source code for Unicode precomposition and filename encoding handling on MacOS X, including functions for path processing, directory reading, and iconv-based string reencoding.

methods.name: has_non_ascii
methods.description: Checks if a string contains non-ASCII characters and counts its length.

methods.name: probe_utf8_pathname_composition
methods.description: Detects and sets Unicode precomposition support based on filesystem tests.

methods.name: precompose_string_if_needed
methods.description: Converts a string from decomposed to precomposed Unicode if needed.

methods.name: precompose_argv_prefix
methods.description: Precomposes command-line arguments and prefix string.

methods.name: precompose_utf8_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory with UTF-8 precomposition support.

methods.name: precompose_utf8_readdir
methods.description: Reads directory entries with UTF-8 precomposition conversion.

methods.name: precompose_utf8_closedir
methods.description: Closes a directory opened with precomposition support.
